Since 1952

A parkland classic, beside the water.

Since 1952, The Lake Club Benoni has been the East Rand’s address for golf done properly. Our 18-hole parkland course winds beneath mature trees and along the lake, and its greens have earned a following of golfers who keep coming back, often for revenge. Many fine rounds have unravelled over the closing four holes, affectionately known as Amen Corner.

More than seven decades of members, friendships and friendly rivalry have given the club a character that cannot be built overnight. Today that heritage sits comfortably beside a state-of-the-art undercover driving range, two bowling greens, four squash courts and a well-merchandised pro shop.

When the round is done, the evening is only beginning. At Joe’s Grill & Pizzeria the clubhouse fills with good food, cold drinks and the easy buzz of a day well spent, whether you are settling a bet from the 18th or celebrating with family.

And for a different kind of game, the new AstroPlex Sports Arena brings a modern, floodlit energy to the grounds: fast, social and made for friends, teams and corporate days.

“The best golf club on the East Rand of Johannesburg, with excellent facilities and great food.”

Our story

A club with a story worth sharing.

Since 1952, The Lake Club Benoni has been a gathering place for the East Rand: golfers, bowlers, families and friends, all drawn to the water’s edge.

The course

Parkland golf with a past.

Established in 1952, our 18-hole parkland course has been shaped by generations of members who care for it. Mature trees frame the fairways, water winds through the grounds, and the greens are renowned for testing golfers of every level, many of whom return for revenge. The closing four holes, affectionately known as Amen Corner, save their drama for last.

Explore the course

Joe’s Grill & Pizzeria

Where the day ends well.

Joe’s is the beating heart of the clubhouse. Come off the course, find a table and let the evening unfold, with grill favourites, fresh pizza, cold drinks and the easy laughter of a Saturday afternoon. A quiet lunch, a post-round debrief or a celebration: Joe’s brings the warmth and energy that make the club feel like home.

Visit Joe’s

AstroPlex Sports Arena

Fresh energy, after dark.

The newest addition to the club brings a modern pulse to the grounds. Floodlit artificial turf, fast games and a lively atmosphere make AstroPlex the place to play after work, meet friends or bring the whole team together. Where the fairways offer tradition, AstroPlex adds pace.
